source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-05: Balancing the Scales

items.name: Slowed
items.text: You have fewer actions. Slowed always includes a value. When you regain your actions at the start of your turn, reduce the number of actions you regain by your slowed value. Because slowed has its effect at the start of your turn, you don't immediately lose actions if you become slowed during your turn.

items.name: Slow
items.text: A zombie is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

items.name: Searing Aura
items.text:
10 feet. The fire-eye zombie emits an aura of heat that causes open wounds to sizzle.

Any living creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie and isn't at full HP must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save save or take 1d4 fire damage as its wounds burn.

Creatures critically hit by the fire-eye zombie's Strikes must attempt this saving throw immediately.

rules.text: On a critical hit a creature must immediately succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save save or take 1d4 fire damage as its wounds burn.

items.name: Eye Throwing
items.text:
A fire-eye zombie can launch its eye at foes. While its eye is out of its head, the fire-eye zombie is Blinded.

At the end of its turn, a fire-eye zombie's eye flies back into its eye socket.
